The resulting 15 pairs are distinct. The standalone checker directly enumerates divisor classes with nef intersections, verifies both formulas on every permutation partition and Frobenius powers, and reproduces the exact classification table. The Picard eigenvalue/zeta formula follows from an actual Frobenius permutation basis, not just point samples. It does not establish isomorphism classification or unrestricted W(E7) inversion.

originality.rationale: The 56-curve and 126-pencil geometric decompositions are expressly prior results. Four relevant primary texts and several semantic searches were compared for logical coverage; Bergvall 2022 treats more general Frobenius conjugacy frequencies but not reconstruction of an S7 partition from a pair of base-field fixed-point statistics. The fifteen-pair injectivity and zeta recovery from that pair are the claimed addition, with a residual risk from implicit permutation characters.
residual_risks: An unindexed table or an unstated immediate representation-character corollary might already encode the fifteen pairs.

value.rationale: The two invariants arise from distinct natural geometry on the same degree-two del Pezzo surface: a 28-point branch-quartic bitangent scheme and a 126-point fibration-class scheme. Neither base-field count alone determines the blowup splitting type (10 and 11 signatures), but their pair determines all 15, immediately reconstructing two finite-étale zeta functions and the surface Hasse–Weil zeta. This is a complete natural arithmetic inversion, not an arbitrary small-field slice or known-value recomputation; the chosen seven-point blowdown is essential.
